steps.title: Set up build.gradle
steps.description: Configure the project's build dependencies, SDK version, and target SDK properties.

steps.title: Configure Manifest
steps.description: Set up application settings, main launcher activity, permissions, and themes.

steps.title: Define App Styles and Layouts
steps.description: Create layouts for authentication screens, note editing form, main list screen, and custom list items.

steps.title: Implement Native Backend API Client
steps.description: Develop custom HTTP connector for Registration, Login, Forgot Password OTP requests, and full CRUD synchronized data endpoints.

steps.title: Define Note Data Model
steps.description: Create a robust Java representation of Note objects with local calculation methods for words parsing.

steps.title: Build Login and Recovery Screens
steps.description: Write logic for validating inputs, posting registration, session token extraction, and executing OTP-based recovery flows.

steps.title: Build Main Notes Dashboard
steps.description: Create note list display, real-time filtering, category tabs, and automatic calculation of statistics locally.

steps.title: Develop Custom Note Editor
steps.description: Assemble Note editor UI with category selection, live data persistence via CRUD API, and inline modifications.

steps.title: Design Custom ListView Adapter
steps.description: Build high-performance adapter to bind note data, format chips, calculate offline word counts dynamically, and manage list actions.

steps.title: Building Cloud Notes
steps.description: Assemble and compile the complete project using Gradle with standard Java 8 settings.
